parameters.Request::__construct: The fields of a PSR-7 request: method, URI, headers, body, protocol version. Callers name them; a parameter object would wrap the message itself.
parameters.Response::__construct: The fields of a PSR-7 response: status, reason phrase, headers, body, protocol version, each set by named argument.
parameters.ServerRequest::__construct: The PSR-7 request fields plus the server parameters PSR-7 keeps on a server request.
parameters.UploadedFile::__construct: The five properties PSR-7 gives an uploaded file: source, size, error, client file name and media type.
